region_coordinates_chk.name: region_coordinates_chk
region_coordinates_chk.value: ("region"."latitude" IS NULL AND "region"."longitude" IS NULL) OR ("region"."latitude" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND "region"."longitude" BETWEEN -180 AND 180 AND "region"."coordinate_source" IS NOT NULL)

sensory_assessed_chk.name: sensory_assessed_chk
sensory_assessed_chk.value: "sensory_observation"."status" <> 'assessed' OR "sensory_observation"."value" IS NOT NULL OR "sensory_observation"."descriptor" IS NOT NULL

sensory_unassessed_chk.name: sensory_unassessed_chk
sensory_unassessed_chk.value: "sensory_observation"."status" = 'assessed' OR ("sensory_observation"."value" IS NULL AND "sensory_observation"."descriptor" IS NULL)

tasting_price_currency_chk.name: tasting_price_currency_chk
tasting_price_currency_chk.value: "tasting"."purchase_price" IS NULL OR "tasting"."currency" IS NOT NULL
